steps.title: Intent
in: Entry 1: who this user is, in their words: goals, skills, constraints, vocabulary
Entry 2: the flow, in their words: who, to do what, expected result
out: Intent: the persona or flow to describe

steps.title: Auditor
steps.actor: AI: a single auditor, who holds the discussion with the human
in: Existing vision, functional guidelines, vocabulary and personas. Selected by script, index first
Entry 2: need entries and user flows whose scope overlaps the flow's, with their log
out: Delta: duplicate, contradiction, hole, gap with the vision, principles or vocabulary (flagged, never blocking). Entry 1: overlap with an existing persona. Entry 2: step without a need entry, missing persona
Proposed scope, drawn from the project vocabulary. To validate at the gate

steps.title: Challenge
steps.actor: Human F, opened by script only if the delta is not empty
in: The delta, short and in fixed form
On request: a question to the auditor about a line of the delta
out: Revised intent, back to the audit
The auditor's answer, read-only, quoting the entry concerned. It modifies no document: only a revised intent has an effect

steps.title: Writer
out: Entry 1: persona proposed in fixed format (goals, skills, constraints, vocabulary, usage context, way of using the product: device, input mode, accessibility needs), without status. Entry 2, missing persona: a persona is proposed in the same pass
Entry 2: proposed user flow: steps, expected observable result at each step, personas concerned, status specified, and its "Candidates" section (one line per step "to create")
Entry 2, if the user flow already exists: a new line added, with the decision, discarded alternatives and reason

steps.title: Validator
steps.actor: Persona distinct from the lead: it receives the deliverable alone, never the discussion

steps.title: Code checks
in: The entry's log, before and after
out: Valid schema, scope from the vocabulary, ambiguous words. Entry 1: no duplicate, way of using the product filled in. Entry 2: cited personas exist, each step has an observable result, each step tied to a need entry or marked "to create" with its candidate request line
Log: previous lines unchanged, a new line if the user flow already exists, full format

steps.title: Judge
steps.actor: AI, two or three fixed questions depending on the entry, citation required

questions.q: Is the persona distinct from the other personas?
Is the persona free of prescribed behavior?
Does the flow contradict an existing criterion?
Is a cited persona irrelevant to this flow?

out: Yes or no. Entry 1: distinct from other personas? free of prescribed behavior? Entry 2: is each step observable? does the flow contradict an existing criterion? is a cited persona irrelevant to this flow?

steps.title: Gate · Review
in: Code checks and judge, all green
out: Persona accepted, or user flow at status specified, scope and log validated
Or changes: back to the intent

steps.title: Accepted · merge
out: Persona in the wiki, available for the Recette

User flow in the wiki, status specified, available for the Recette. Its "Candidates" section: one line per step "to create", in the format of the Need intent (source, who, expected, why, proposed scope), at status candidate

contract: Entry 1: a type of user to describe. Entry 2: a flow to describe, often across several features.
An accepted persona, or a user flow at status specified with, in the flow's entry, a "Candidates" section: one line per step "to create", that Need can pick up. Both are available for the Recette.
Human F, at the gate. No human T.
notes: A script opens it only if the auditor's delta is not empty. Otherwise writing follows directly. The discussion is a loop between the human and the auditor, with no maximum number of rounds: at each round, the auditor receives the delta and the messages exchanged since its last round.
The steps are identical. Only what the code checks and the judge verify changes, and the type of what comes out.
It has no status and is not itself recetted: it steers the Recettes that use it.
It follows that of the needs it cites. "Verified" is derived from the last successful Recette whose flow and persona hashes match.
The AI rephrases, it does not invent
The intent comes from human F, with what they know of their real users. A persona invented by the AI would only be a cliché.

Status derived by script: candidate while no need cites the step, launched once a need entry cites it as source, dropped if the human discards it by modifying the flow, with its reason in the log. Nothing is created automatically.
Criteria stay in the need entries. The user flow chains them and does not redefine them.
doc.lede: A human F describes a persona or a flow. The result is a wiki entry that the Recette uses to steer or define what it plays. The AI rephrases, it does not invent.
